meta.title: 一户建为何比自建房好看很多？

scenes.title_cn: 开场：好看的问题出在哪
scenes.title_en: Opening: Why Does It Look Better?
scenes.context: 日本一户建明明没啥复杂设计，看着就是很舒服。问题出在哪？有没有简单通用的设计规律？
sentences: It has no fancy design at all.
有没有通用的设计规律。
Is there a simple universal rule?
paraphrase: It has no fancy design at all.
Is there a simple universal rule?
scenes.speak: It has no fancy design at all. Yet it just looks right. Is there a simple universal rule?

scenes.context: 动漫里的房子都是下大上小的结构，降低整体重心，给人温馨感；我们的房子上下一样，像一块笨重的水泥压在地上。
sentences: 动漫里的房子下大上小。
Anime houses are wider at the base.
A low center of gravity feels cozy.
我们的房子像笨重的水泥块。
Ours sit like a heavy block of concrete.
paraphrase: Anime houses are wider at the base.
用center of gravity换一种说法
A low center of gravity feels cozy.
Ours sit like a heavy block of concrete.
scenes.speak: Anime houses are wider at the base. A low center of gravity feels cozy. Ours sit like a heavy block of concrete.

scenes.context: 如果小新家在中国，可能会变成上下一样厚重的样子，而且三楼恐怕还是空的。
sentences: 小新家在中国会变成这样。
Xiaoxin's house in China might look like this.
The third floor would probably be empty.
paraphrase: Xiaoxin's house in China might look like this.
The third floor would probably be empty.
scenes.speak: Xiaoxin's house in China might look like this. The third floor would probably be empty.

scenes.context: 糟糕的外立面是丑感的精髓。自建房反光的不锈钢、彩色窗户、窗帘、细碎小瓷砖都是不协调因素，统一就能好看。
sentences: 糟糕的外立面是丑感的精髓。
A bad facade is the secret to ugly.
不锈钢和彩色窗户都不协调。
Steel and colorful windows break the harmony.
Unifying it makes it look better.
paraphrase: A bad facade is the secret to ugly.
Steel and colorful windows break the harmony.
Unifying it makes it look better.
scenes.speak: A bad facade is the secret to ugly. Steel and colorful windows break the harmony. Unifying it makes it look better.

scenes.context: 一户建材质不超过两种且反光度相似，颜色也是每层各一种、色调相近、饱和度低；细碎小瓷砖缝隙太多显得乱，碎墙面只能做装饰不能做主体。
sentences: They use at most two materials.
paraphrase: They use at most two materials.
scenes.speak: They use at most two materials. Close tones, low saturation. Too many joints look messy.

scenes.context: 错落感是决定房子有无设计感的核心：工地板房看起来很呆板，稍微给些凹凸设计感觉就来了。
sentences: 错落感是设计感的核心。
Stepping is the heart of design.
呆板的房子加些凹凸就活了。
A plain box gains life with a few recesses.
paraphrase: Stepping is the heart of design.
A plain box gains life with a few recesses.
scenes.speak: Stepping is the heart of design. A plain box gains life with a few recesses.

scenes.context: 给廉价的建筑加上光影，给冰冷的建筑加上绿植，给单薄的建筑加上院墙，都是增加错落感的原理。
sentences: Add light and shadow to cheap buildings.
Add a courtyard wall to thin ones.
paraphrase: 用light and shadow换一种说法
Add light and shadow to cheap buildings.
Add a courtyard wall to thin ones.
scenes.speak: Add light and shadow to cheap buildings. Add plants to cold ones. Add a courtyard wall to thin ones.

scenes.context: 做一栋好看房子的公式：先搭上小下大、有些错落感的结构，选一组色调相近颜色低的颜色，最后摆上一些绿植，一个平平无奇的房子就盖好了。
sentences: Start with a top-light, bottom-wide frame.
选一组色调相近的颜色。
Pick one family of close tones.
paraphrase: Start with a top-light, bottom-wide frame.
Pick one family of close tones.
scenes.speak: Start with a top-light, bottom-wide frame. Pick one family of close tones. Finish with a few plants.
